topics.name: Command Argument Schema
topics.purpose: Define exact positional/named argument, option, target and value semantics for executable commands so parsing and validation never depend on undocumented string heuristics.

semantics.type_rule: Each argument declares type/schema and validation constraints.
semantics.target_rule: Command targets resolve by explicit canonical identity/address where available.
semantics.value_rule: Argument values remain inert until the resolved command operation consumes them.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown arguments/options fail or follow explicit extension policy.
semantics.help_rule: Argument schema may generate short/long help usage metadata.
semantics.authority_rule: Valid argument syntax does not grant target authority.

invariants.rule: Executable commands resolve by exact canonical identity and schema, cross one governed dispatcher boundary, and never infer authority from capability presence or parser success.

references.purpose: Parser validates against command argument schema.
